# Two Hour Maids

> Flat-rate house cleaning in Minneapolis-St. Paul, Minnesota. A team of two cleaners at a set start time, and the price shows on the
> booking page before any details are given. The person books on the booking page or by calling or texting; assistants cannot book for them.

## Book
- [Booking page](https://www.twohourmaids.com/book-now): the only place to book. Pick bedrooms and bathrooms, see the price, choose a start time. Deep link: https://www.twohourmaids.com/book-now?service=two_hour&zip=55441&date=YYYY-MM-DD&time=0900&beds=2&baths=1 (service: two_hour, checklist or four_hour; time: 0900, 1140 or 1440).
- Call or text (763) 227-9124. Email Owner@TwoHourMaids.com.

## Open times (read only)
- GET https://isbhlmihbibdnajvicrj.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-availability?zip=55441&service=two_hour&days=7 (or city=plymouth instead of zip; days 1 to 14; start=YYYY-MM-DD optional)
- Returns { v, business, service, area: { served, community, zip }, timezone, times: [{ date, day_label, start, start_label, arrival_window, book_url }], notes }. Each book_url opens the booking page with that time picked; booking and payment happen only there. No customer data, no holds, cached 5 minutes.

## Facts and prices (approved; before taxes and fees)
- Two Hour Maids: flat-rate house cleaning in Minneapolis-St. Paul, Minnesota. Phone and text (763) 227-9124, email Owner@TwoHourMaids.com.
- A team of 2 cleaners at a set start time: 9:00 AM, 11:40 AM or 2:40 PM, each with a 30-minute arrival window. Same-day cleans when a team is free, up to an hour before a start time. Book up to 8 weeks ahead.
- Two Hour Clean: 2 cleaners for 2 hours; kitchen, bathrooms, floors and general tidying, plus up to 2 special requests; no extras. $222 one time, $189 weekly, $189 every 2 weeks, $200 every 4 weeks, $200 every 6 weeks.
- Extra half hour on a Two Hour Clean: $40.
- First-time code SPONGE: a one-time Two Hour Clean is $189.
- The Checklist Clean: every room, every visit, priced by how long the home takes (two cleaners at an hourly rate that falls with repeat visits); from $222 one time for a small home. A 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home is $323 one time, $282 every 2 weeks and $299 every 4 weeks.
- The first 2 cleans for every new customer are Catch-Up Cleans: the first details the kitchen and bathrooms, the second the bedrooms, living and dining areas. It is not likely we can get everything done in them; we get the home up to speed, and what is not reached is done free next visit. We promise excellence, not perfection.
- The Rotating Detail Plan: an add-on for a repeat Checklist Clean that starts after the 2 Catch-Up Cleans. Every visit is the full Checklist Clean plus one Focus room given extra detail, in turn: kitchen and eating areas, bathrooms, bedrooms, living and dining areas. From $16 a visit; $26 a visit for a 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home every 2 weeks.
- A first visit is the Two Hour Clean or The Checklist Clean, the customer's choice; for a home that has not had a professional clean in a while we recommend The Checklist Clean. The Four Hour Home Detailing comes after the first clean.
- Four Hour Home Detailing: $385, 9:00 AM to 1:30 PM, a full clean, a free half hour, then detailing from the customer's list.
- Prices are before taxes and fees. The booking page shows the price before any details are given.
- Cancel or skip more than 48 hours ahead: free. Inside 48 hours: $50, waived for a first clean, an illness once a year and loyal customers.
- Buy six, gift one: every 6th clean earns a free clean to give a friend, automatically, forever.
- Policy (Two Hour Clean): The Two Hour Clean is a fixed two-hour service. It is not eligible for re-cleans or refunds.
- Policy (Checklist Clean): If a room on your checklist does not meet your expectations, tell us within 48 hours and we will review it. We can come back to fix it, or refund the part that was missed.
- Policy (Four Hour Home Detailing): The Four Hour Detailing is booked as a fixed block of time. Please tell us about any concern within 48 hours and we will review it.
- Our cleaners are W-2 employees, never gig workers or subcontractors. Insured. Background checks for every new hire.
- Service area: 47 communities: Apple Valley, Blaine, Bloomington, Brooklyn Center, Brooklyn Park, Champlin, Chanhassen, Chaska, Columbia Heights, Coon Rapids, Crystal, Dayton, Eagan, Eden Prairie, Edina, Excelsior, Fridley, Golden Valley, Hanover, Hopkins, Long Lake, Loretto, Maple Grove, Maple Plain, Maplewood, Medina, Mendota Heights, Minneapolis, Minnetonka, Mound, Navarre, New Brighton, Oakdale, Plymouth, Richfield, Robbinsdale, Rogers, Roseville, Savage, Shakopee, Shoreview, St Louis Park, St Paul, Vadnais Heights, Wayzata, West St Paul, White Bear Lake. The full ZIP list is on /service-area.
- Facilities by Two Hour Maids (commercial): free walkthrough, one price per visit, billed on one monthly statement, month to month, 30 days' notice, no exit fee; a 12-month agreement, after the Property Elevation Plan, adds a price lock and loyalty rewards.
- Property managers: unit turnovers booked by text, a private portal, one monthly statement per account by building, due in 15 days, 2 people per turnover.
